reviews.text:
We loved the experience. It was the first time we'd left our dog at a dog hotel, and I have to say Huellitas Resort set the bar incredibly high.
My dog ​​couldn't have been better cared for and pampered. During his stay, they posted stories of his adventure and gave me updates on his mood. In the end, they returned him to me looking absolutely gleaming and even with souvenirs.

Thank you to everyone for your attention, from the person who answers WhatsApp messages, the reception staff, the grooming service, and the caregivers; who, by the way, we asked to see before leaving him without prior notice, and they welcomed us with open arms. I also applaud them for this because the place was spotless and extremely secure.
WE WILL DEFINITELY BE BACK! 🫶🏻

pretty good service, its nice they upload some instagram stories daily so you can see your lomito once in a while
they show you all the facilities since day one and every day i pick up my lomito she is as happy as she can be... and tired hahaha

It had been highly recommended to me and now I understand why. My dog ​​is very nervous and fearful around other dogs, and the women there were incredibly attentive to him. I even saw him socializing with them and all the other dogs in their stories! I loved it! 🫶🏼
A good option for leaving your dogs
Very happy with the bathing service I had done, my dog ​​came out really white and was very happy!
The service was great, they treated my dogs very well and they looked great after their spa day and they even put a little star on my dog's forehead 🤭🥹
I loved how they took care of my little girl! She arrived happy and the bath was 10/10, they removed all her knots and we were very pleased! 🫶🏻
The best place to leave your dog without worrying about anything: safe, happy, and loved! Congratulations!

I went to check out the Valle Real branch, and the service and the entire team there seemed good.

Unfortunately, what ruined all the good points was the terrible smell!

They have artificial grass, and that's where the dogs relieve themselves. As soon as they opened the door for me to go in, I said, "Oops!" How awful! Everything smelled really, really bad, and the worst part is that the waste releases harmful particles that are very unpleasant to smell all day long, for both humans and pets. It's not only disgusting to be in that kind of environment, but the dogs are completely covered in that smell.

The dogs are completely permeated with that smell.
I left, and the smell lingered for quite a while, and my stomach was upset.

This lack of hygiene and planning in pet grooming areas needs to be addressed. 🤢
I had never seen it so clean as after going to Huellitas Resort Valle Real
They don't answer the phone, whether you're asking for information about a pet or any service.

I had a very good experience, the service was excellent from beginning to end, they sent me a photo of my dog ​​every day to let me know how he was doing 🐾😊 I highly recommend them and I would definitely go back again.

Excellent service at Huellitas! The staff was very attentive and caring; my dog ​​was happy, clean, and calm. They treated him with great love and professionalism. The facilities are clean and safe. 100% recommended for grooming and boarding.
They were super nice to my dogs. I highly recommend them.

The care processes and procedures are truly exceptional. They have excellent organization of schedules, care protocols, and responsibilities for each employee, as well as safety measures for receiving and handing over puppies. It's an excellent place to leave with peace of mind, knowing your pet will be in good hands.
Excellent service.
Lucky is always very happy when we leave him, and we love it when you send us photos of your days with us.
WARNING!!!!!!!! They treat their employees badly, but the worst part is that at night they leave the dogs locked up alone... The employees have a voice, but their little dogs don't.....
Hi Zara! Thank you for your rating. I hope you're doing well. We'd love to hear more about your experience and how we can help. Please feel free to contact us via WhatsApp. Have a great day!
Excellent Hotel

I left my three Pomeranian puppies at Huellitas Resort for eight days, expecting them to be well cared for. I want to clarify from the start that my other two dogs returned healthy and well, and I didn't notice any signs that they had a bad experience during their stay. In fact, in the videos they sent me, they didn't appear uncomfortable or unwell, and I do acknowledge that.

However, I had a situation with Richard that left me quite dissatisfied.

When they bathed them before returning them to me, I was informed that Richard had a piece of feces stuck to his tail area. At the time, I thought it was something superficial and that cleaning, bathing, and using the toilet would resolve it. However, upon returning from my vacation, I noticed that Richard had started constantly dragging his rear end on the floor.

Upon checking him, I realized that the area was quite injured. I took him to the vet the next day, and she explained that the injury looked practically like a severe burn or irritation. He is currently undergoing treatment, including medication, cream, and antiseptic for cleaning. Each time he is cleaned, Richard experiences considerable pain and even cries. He also had a rather unpleasant discharge, although thankfully he is now improving.

My main concern isn't what happened after Richard was returned to me. I acknowledge and appreciate that, once they learned of the situation, they were willing to take responsibility and offer care free of charge. However, my concern is what might have happened DURING the 8 days he was there.

I don't know when Richard started feeling uncomfortable, nor how long he might have had that area sore or irritated. If it was already detected that he had feces stuck to that area, I believe there should have been a more thorough examination and cleaning, as well as immediate communication with me if any injury or discomfort was observed.

There was also another aspect I wasn't happy about. My three dogs always live together, and since there were three of them, I felt the space they had was sufficient. However, they had to share the space with another dog. I completely understand the idea of ​​socialization and coexistence, and I have nothing against it, but in our case, my dogs' beds ended up covered in the other dog's fur and smelling different than they normally do. For me, given that they are three dogs who already live together and are small dogs, I would have preferred that only the three of them remain in their space.

I'm not saying my dogs were unwell throughout their stay, because my other two returned fine, and from the videos, they didn't seem to be having a bad time. My dissatisfaction is mainly focused on what happened with Richard and the lack of information at the time the problem might have arisen.

I also want to clarify that I live quite far from the facility. Although I appreciate that they later offered to care for him free of charge, it wasn't feasible for me to transport him there daily: it involves approximately an hour and a half of traffic, or even more, depending on the day. Therefore, while I appreciate their willingness to take responsibility afterward, what was important to me was that the situation was detected and addressed during his stay, or at least that I was informed promptly.

I hope they take our case as a learning experience to improve their inspection, hygiene, cleaning, and communication protocols with owners. I don't think my dogs had a bad stay overall, but as an owner, I do believe that a situation like Richard's shouldn't go unnoticed for so many days.

For all the above reasons, my rating is 2 stars. I sincerely hope this experience helps them prevent something similar from happening to another dog.

I don't recommend this place... they're terrible. My puppy came out of there extremely sick. They injured his paw and he also had a throat infection. I explained everything and asked them to pay for the medicine, but they never did, and they certainly didn't take responsibility for my dog. It literally took a month for his paw to heal, and it wasn't from another dog bite; they hurt him until his paw was so badly wounded. I don't recommend it at all; my puppy was terribly mistreated.

Excellent service! They're the only ones I trust to care for my dog ​​because I know they're monitoring him and always posting videos of the dogs to give us peace of mind. This is the second year I've left my dog ​​with them, and I haven't had any bad experiences; on the contrary, they've been very beneficial for my dog. 🥰 …
The service is wonderful! The best place for my dog!
The service is excellent, what I don't like is that they try to charge extra for things you didn't ask for.
I loved the attention my dog ​​received from their spa; they pampered and spoiled her. I highly recommend them!
Excellent service. They treat dogs wonderfully. I'm so glad I found this place.
They took very good care of my dog ​​and were always in contact with me.
Excellent place. Great service and my dog ​​always comes home happy.

Matilda was the happiest there. She returned happy, stress-free, and without any stomach problems.

They have a good vaccination and deworming schedule so that all the dogs that come in are healthy.
Excellent service and attention!
Everything was excellent, my dog ​​stayed for 6 days and came home very happy, 100% recommended
They did a great job on Bubu, highly recommended
My four furry friends and I love Huellitas; it's a place where they treat the dogs incredibly well and really care about them 💖
I love the service, they have very good attention and treatment of pets.

I don't recommend this place because the service was terrible. They didn't give me any updates or photos of my dog. They weren't even able to administer his medication themselves, which they force you to buy from the start.
They made me go and give him the medication myself and charged me for a day of doggy daycare that wasn't used, even though it was supposed to be free as part of a promotion. They never followed up with me again.

I understand that my dog ​​isn't friendly with new people. But I'm surprised that there's no staff capable of handling situations like this, especially since he's a 2kg dog. Incidentally, he contracted Bordetella a few days later. We don't know if it was from contagion or from the vaccine they made us give him.
Excellent service, my service was like a dog hotel and everything was great.
Great service from the staff
Excellent service
Hi Roberto, good morning! We're glad you enjoyed our service. We love having you here, you're always welcome. We're here for you if you need anything. 🐶🏨🐾 …
They're the best. The most attentive! They solve any problem I have. And it's really convenient that they come to your home to pick up your dogs.
The people who helped me on WhatsApp, at reception, and at the vet were all very kind and clear. Congratulations!
Amazing!! It's the only place where they truly clean Lola, and she loves going there!! From the WhatsApp support to the reception and service, it's 100/10

The best place to trust my pets 🐶🐶🐶🐶, highly recommended! They treat my fur babies incredibly well 🙌 They love going to Huellitas for their bath and also to the hotel, and they always come back super happy! I wouldn't trade them for anyone! Please keep up the good work :) The place is always super clean, and the veterinary service is spectacular; my dogs love the vet! Everyone is always very professional! I highly recommend them!!
Highly recommended, the customer service is excellent. I took my dog ​​for a bath and he looked so handsome! 💞 …
I love leaving my dog ​​there because they take great care of her and she has a blast playing with her friends. Highly recommended.
Thank you for your trust.
They have excellent service, I highly recommend them. I went on a trip and stayed at Rocky's place and it was a 10/10! They have great facilities and the staff is excellent! 🤗 …
I was recommended this place, and today I confirmed that it's a good place where they take care of your pet as if it were at home.
Great location ✅👍🏻 …
Chiqui and I love ❤️

We recently visited our three café owners ☕️ and had a less than pleasant experience. The review has improved because I believe that, from a professional standpoint, negatively impacts a business. What we didn't appreciate at the time was that they didn't tell us how to address what was happening to our puppies when they were very ill 🐶🐶🐶. We hope to return someday and have a different experience. Today, all three dogs are healthy.

We removed our 1-star rating because we also run a business and understand the impact of reviews. We apologize for not communicating sooner and sincerely request that you please remove any fake reviews about experiences at our café—reviews about things that didn't actually happen or from people we don't know. Thank you very much 🤎
It's a great place!!! They make my dog ​​look beautiful and she always leaves very happy.

I do not recommend this place as a hotel for your dog. I left my dog ​​there twice now, and I regret both times.
The first time, they returned him to me with the flu, and they didn't mention it at all. I decided to give them another chance because it was peak season, and they told me it was common for that reason.
But this second and final time, they returned my dog ​​very drowsy from some anti-stress powder (which they prescribed during his stay) and with cuts on his head and behind his ears. I notified them of what I saw via message the same day they returned him, and their only solution was to say that sometimes dogs play roughly and they never noticed (strange because my dog ​​couldn't stand having your hand touched the cut area), and that they could check him if I wanted.
They supposedly have a manager who checks on the dogs daily, and there was no mention of what happened during his stay. They return your dog bathed, and apparently, they didn't notice anything during the bath either. Furthermore, for two whole days they forgot to send me a photo or video of my dog ​​(when you hire them they tell you they'll always upload updates). I had to insist to get them to show me and ask if something had happened.

The positive aspects are that they have a good space for your dog and some caregivers are more attentive and have a veterinarian on staff. However, there are flaws in how they communicate updates about your dog, or perhaps they have insufficient staff.

In conclusion: at least in my experience, I don't recommend this branch.
I was very happy with the care and services my Crayola and Galleta received at Huellitas. Crayola got her teeth cleaned, bathed, and groomed. Galleta just went to the spa. Everything was great!

Excellent service and kindness from the staff. They always make sure Mole receives the best care and affection. (They spoil him rotten 🤣)
I feel at ease every time he stays overnight or goes to daycare, and I have complete confidence in the way they treat Mole. …
Excellent place for our dog, very well looked after
Excellent service, very friendly, my dog ​​loves being there, he always comes back super happy and they always treat him so well. ✨

In my experience, my 8-month-old Cocker Spaniel came home very sad, with no appetite and scared! We had to take him there a month ago, and to this day he's still scared and won't eat his kibble. He gets scared if you approach him, and so on... his behavior is very, very strange! He used to be cheerful, very active, and happy!
Also, when we arrived at the hotel and paid for his stay, they mentioned extra charges that we had never been told about before... and when we asked for a refund, they said it wasn't possible... Our experience was terrible. From what we've seen since then, we think they beat him or kept him locked up the whole time! Lukas, our puppy, stayed for 5 days, and he truly came back completely different! Very, very sad... they argue that the dogs usually behave this way because, according to them, they miss being in the "pseudo-hotel."
NO, DON'T TAKE YOUR DOGS THERE!
Note: I had to give one star... because I wasn't allowed to post...

Thank you so much for your rating, Ale! We really appreciate it!

We hope to see you soon ♥️

Best regards 😃
The most fun hotel for my dogs. They look so happy throughout their stay. The service is excellent; they answer all our questions and take wonderful care of them ❤️ I love Huellitas

This is the first time I've left my three little ones at a boarding facility, and honestly, I had an excellent experience!
I loved that I could see them having fun in their posts the whole time, and that kept me very calm.
The staff was very professional and caring, thank you so much!
Excellent service!
Excellent service! I was able to enjoy a very special day knowing my baby dog ​​was safe and well cared for!! Thank you 🙂 …

Thank you so much for your rating, José, we really appreciate it!

We hope to see you soon ♥️

I loved it!!! One of the best hotels, I truly felt at ease with the attention they gave me. I was one of those who kept asking about Nashla and Chiara (especially since one is older and I was worried about her), but they took such good care of her, and the little one was thrilled! When I went to pick them up, they were so happy. They were given a little gift bag full of treats with a note, which was such a special touch! At first, I was really nervous about leaving them, but I was so pleasantly surprised that they loved it. I even think they miss spending time with the friends they made... Nashla and Chiara will definitely be back! Thank you for taking such good care of them and for the quality of everything... never change that! 🙌🏻✨🤍🐶🐶

They're so nice to the animals; my dog ​​loves staying there. They're always uploading videos of your dogs so you can be sure they're having a good time 🥰 I've been using their services for a long time now and I've always had a great experience …

My dogs just spent a few days on vacation at the best resort ever!! They were pampered, taken care of, and treated incredibly well!!! All in a lovely and safe environment. I love you, little paw prints!!!

Thank you so much for your rating, Esau, we really appreciate it!

We hope to see you soon ♥️
Excellent service and attention
The best place… our dog always comes back super happy, the service is excellent, and the staff is very friendly and well-trained! ❤️
My dog ​​was able to socialize and overcome her fear of other dogs. I hadn't taken her to social events in a while, and she was starting to have trouble mingling with them.

The service is excellent, with a great infrastructure, logistics, and customer service. The facilities are amazing and very clean.
The staff's communication was very assertive and quick. Of all the places I've left my pet, this is the best. Highly recommended.

The service was, as always, fantastic, with great attention and service. We were very happy, and Terry was even happier.

Thank you so much for your rating, Salvador, we really appreciate it!

We hope to see you soon ♥️
I fully trust them with my dog; he always comes back happy from his stay at the little hotel, and their veterinary care is also excellent.
Slash loves being with you all, thank you!!
Excellent place, they were very caring and attentive to my dog, we are happy with the services

As my great-great-grandfather once said, I would have liked to be a dog so that I would be treated the same. It's an excellent experience; you get along with your buddies, you have fun, and they pamper you—pure bliss.
Thank you so much for your rating and for letting us pamper your baby 😍 …

Terrible, your dog is treated like a kidnapping victim. The first few days are great, they send you videos and the dog looks happy. Then suddenly you get a message saying the dog isn't eating, and they ask if you authorize feeding him wet food, so you agree.

The problem arises when the exact same thing happens the next day, only this time they don't even bother to include your dog's name in the message. It's the same message they send to all owners, which says verbatim:
“Hello, good day! A little while ago, I received a report that XX left food in his bowl. What do you think about adding some wet food to help motivate him to finish his bowl? 🤩” By this point, they don't even include your pet's name; it's just copy and paste so you pay “the fee.” So, I stopped accepting this extra charge, and what happened next is that my dog ​​stopped appearing in the stories, and even worse, they reported that he had a cut on his paw because “he fought with other dogs.” Incredibly dubious, but from then on, there were no more stories about how the dog was doing. And when they returned him to me, the poor puppy was completely filthy, smelling of urine and covered in stains. Excrement, a sign that he was locked up, alone, separated from the other dogs because I didn't want to pay "the fee." That's the care they give your pet.
Thank you for your five paw prints, Jairo! We hope your dog enjoyed the five paw print experience!

I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE AT ALL. IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR DOG, LOOK FOR OTHER OPTIONS!

HORRIBLE SERVICE. I left my dog ​​hoping this place would be a good option, and I was completely disappointed.

They try to squeeze money out of you for EVERYTHING. Vaccinations that ALL veterinary clinics and dog hospitals tell you are annual, they say are every six months, and of course, they sell you the vaccines after your dog is already there so they can stay. The same goes for medications; they make up some illness your dog has and then, of course, give you medicine.

According to them, they check all the dogs before they enter and they have to be in perfect health and thoroughly checked before they can be admitted. However, they returned my dog ​​sick, something that has NEVER happened to me at any other dog daycare/hospital (and obviously, when I told them, they didn't take responsibility and they ALREADY KNEW he was sick. They didn't tell us ANYTHING, and when we realized it, we didn't know what it was. We had to spend money on an emergency vet visit, and when we called them, they said, "Oh, yeah, he got sick here").

To top it all off, I found out that they kept my dog ​​isolated for two days straight. When I asked the first time, they lied, saying he wasn't, and then, when I didn't see him in their stories during the first few days, they had to admit that he was isolated.

TERRIBLE SERVICE, FULL OF LIES, CONFUSION, AND A COMPLETE DESPERATION TO PROFIT FROM EVERYTHING.
Thank you Uriel, for your five paw prints, we hope you were very happy with our services and we look forward to seeing you and your dog back soon.

Terrible service! My dog ​​ended up very sick with the flu and they didn't take good care of her. Super bad service. I'm about to sue that hotel and the vet, everyone there. Terrible, terrible service.
Excellent service, the facilities are great and spacious, and they even gave us treats when we picked up our dogs. 🐶 …
They are unreliable and have no commitment to delivery times. I waited an hour for my order and they didn't even bother to call to say they were late. Very poor service.
Valeria, thank you for your five little footprints! We're glad to know you like our services.

We love Huellitas! Every time Leika goes, she leaves super happy. They always take such good care of her, and the service is top-notch! They always keep you informed about everything, and the spa service is excellent. The reception staff are incredibly friendly. 10/10!!!

Huellitas Resort is an amazing place for dogs. From the first time I took my dog, I felt so much more confident seeing how clean everything is and how attentive they are to each pet. You can tell the team truly enjoys what they do and cares for the furry friends as if they were their own. My dog ​​always leaves happy and relaxed.
It's definitely my go-to place, and I highly recommend it. I love Huellitas Resort ❤️

We left our dog with them for a few days while we were out of town, and they were incredibly attentive. We loved that they sent us photos and videos, and they were also very attentive to his needs. He went from being a bit unsociable with other dogs to making several friends. Highly recommended! 👌 …
Excellent service, very attentive at all times. I had a personal issue where I couldn't pick up my dog ​​and they supported me every step of the way. 100% recommended
Excellent service! They provided me with details about my stay throughout the entire period and they even sell food in case I forget it!
Excellent facilities and maintenance.
My dog ​​was very happy after his stay. He was very well cared for, and the staff were very friendly and attentive.
Excellent experience, my dog ​​was very well cared for at the hotel, highly recommended.
They were always so nice to Yuna, and she came back happy. Thank you so much.

When you board your furry friends at Huellitas Resort, you can rest assured that they'll be in a safe place and receiving the care they need. I've boarded my dog ​​there on more than one occasion, and it's always been a great experience.

I loved the place; the reception staff was very professional, and it was so easy to drop off my pet without any hassle. The services they offer at least met my expectations, as they have veterinarians on staff if needed. My dog ​​was happy, looked great in the stories they shared, and I would definitely leave him there again.
My only suggestion is that they post more tagged stories about the dogs, because in my case, I had to check them all to see if I could spot him. Luckily, I did! :D

They took such good care of my Nachito and spoiled him rotten. They sent me updates on how he was doing and even posted about him on their Instagram stories. When I went to pick him up, they gave him a little farewell gift.

I definitely recommend them and would trust my dog ​​here again :) 💖
We really liked Huellitas Hotel; they're constantly uploading photos of the puppies.
Excellent place for my dog, he always arrives happy and comes back even more :) very good service from the staff.
Excellent service
As always, my fur babies were happy. Thank you so much for everything! They were very well cared for and looked after. We'll be back soon!!!
I'm sure my puppies enjoyed their stay
Excellent dog hotel! My puppy always leaves super happy! Thank you so much!
Excellent place to leave your dogs, highly recommended!!

Great experience! I left my two dogs at a kennel for the first time for three weeks, and they were treated very well. They post daily content on Instagram where you can see them playing and being cared for. The facilities are in good condition. They also gave them a bath and haircut, and everything was great!

An amazing option for pet care. They always come home happy and relaxed.
I received constant updates on their well-being and support for anything my pet needed.
My little one enjoyed his stay, he left happy and tired!! Facilities, service, attention and care 100/10 thanks Huellitas Resort
They provide good service.

I boarded my furry friend last week at Huellitas Resort Valle Real, and it was a truly wonderful experience. I appreciate the safety measures they take for their guests, from the vaccination and deworming checks they perform, to the peace of mind that the dogs there are healthy. They gave me a tour, and most of the staff were very friendly. I wish they would send more photos of the dogs, but the truth is, communication was excellent throughout. They answered all my questions and were attentive to any concerns that arose during my stay. Thank you for everything!
Excellent place!!! I can leave with peace of mind knowing my babies are in good hands; they came back very happy ❤️❤️❤️
Hi Maria Fernanda, we're so sorry your experience wasn't the best. We'd love to know what part you weren't satisfied with so we can improve and always provide better service. Best regards.
Oxal, thank you for your 5 little footprints, it's great to know that you liked the service.
Thank you so much for taking care of my dog!

Terrible service. They told me they had to shave my dog ​​because he had a lot of knots, but they gave him a terrible haircut and burned his neck. It's clear the cut wasn't done by a professional. They charged me upfront, and when I asked for a refund, they said it didn't apply because he had a warranty and I could bring him back, which I don't understand why, because they literally irritated his skin and there was no way to reshape the cut. My dog ​​looked very sad and was trembling a lot.
A very sad experience.
The best for your puppy: safety, cleanliness, good treatment, but above all, excellent service, always attentive and friendly.
